notes: The cohorts surface sat on "Resolving membership…" across two daemon restarts and three separate attempts to diagnose it. The mechanism was never exotic: state.cohSel is PERSISTED, so every page load re-opens the same cohort detail and re-issues /cm/cohort_detail, which awaits co.resolve() before it answers anything — so a cohort whose resolve outruns the fetch leaves the panel on its loading placeholder forever, and does it again on the next reload. What made it undiagnosable was not the hang. inspect_terminal what=state disclosed thesis_selected, watchlist_selected, portfolio_selected and se
